snippet.title: Asterika: Phantom Rose Refrain - Bullet Hell Rhythm Game!
snippet.description:
🔥 Play the FREE Demo NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690850/Asterika_Phantom_Rose_Refrain

Move with the beat! Asterika: Phantom Rose Refrain is a challenging bullet hell rhythm game. There's no falling notes to press. Weave through obstacle patterns, move to the music, and master the chaos on the grid!

🎮 Wishlist and play the demo on Steam today!
